<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><span style="font-size: 10pt"></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><b>EXPLANATORY NOTE</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">This Amendment No. 1 on Form 8-K/A (this &#8220;Amendment&#8221;) amends
the Current Report on Form 8-K of American Fusion, Inc. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission
on October 6, 2026 (the &#8220;Original Report&#8221;), which reported the resignation of JV CPA INC. (&#8220;JV CPA&#8221;) as the Company&#8217;s
independent registered public accounting firm. The Company is filing this Amendment to report the engagement of MBP Global LLP as its
new independent registered public accounting firm, as required by Item 304(a)(2) of Regulation S-K. In addition, the Company is correcting
its press release dated October 7, 2026, which incorrectly stated that JV CPA resigned citing health reasons and that JV CPA&#8217;s Exhibit
16.1 letter confirmed its agreement with the Company&#8217;s statements. JV CPA did not state any reason for its resignation, and the
Company attributes none. JV CPA&#8217;s letter agrees only with the statements concerning JV CPA in paragraph (a) of Item 4.01 of the
Original Report and states that JV CPA is not in a position to agree or disagree with the Company&#8217;s other statements. JV CPA did
not review or approve the press release. Except as set forth herein, this Amendment does not amend or update any other information contained
in the Original Report.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt/115% Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>Item 4.01 Changes in Registrant&#8217;s Certifying Accountant.</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><i>(a) Resignation of Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm.</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On October 1, 2026, JV CPA INC. (&#8220;JV CPA&#8221;)
notified the Company that it resigned as the Company&#8217;s independent registered public accounting firm, effective October 1, 2026.
JV CPA&#8217;s resignation applies to all further audit and review services, including the review of the Company&#8217;s interim financial
information for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 and the audit of the Company&#8217;s financial statements for the year ending December
31, 2026.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">JV CPA&#8217;s report on the Company&#8217;s consolidated
financial statements as of and for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024 did not contain an adverse opinion or a disclaimer of opinion,
and was not qualified or modified as to uncertainty, audit scope or accounting principles, except that such report contained an explanatory
paragraph regarding substantial doubt about the Company&#8217;s ability to continue as a going concern.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">During the Company&#8217;s fiscal years ended
December 31, 2025 and 2024 and the subsequent interim period through October 1, 2026, there were (i) no &#8220;disagreements&#8221; (as
defined in Item 304(a)(1)(iv) of Regulation S-K and the related instructions) with JV CPA on any matter of accounting principles or practices,
financial statement disclosure, or auditing scope or procedure, which disagreements, if not resolved to the satisfaction of JV CPA, would
have caused JV CPA to make reference to the subject matter of the disagreements in connection with its reports, and (ii) no &#8220;reportable
events&#8221; (as defined in Item 304(a)(1)(v) of Regulation S-K).</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company provided JV CPA with a copy of the
disclosures contained in the Original Report and requested that JV CPA furnish the Company with a letter addressed to the Securities and
Exchange Commission stating whether it agrees with the statements made therein. A copy of JV CPA&#8217;s letter, dated October 6, 2026,
was filed as Exhibit 16.1 to the Original Report.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><i>(b) Engagement of New Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm.</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On October 20, 2026, the Company engaged MBP Global
LLP (&#8220;MBP Global&#8221;) as its new independent registered public accounting firm to audit the Company&#8217;s consolidated financial
statements for the year ending December 31, 2026 and review its interim financial statements for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">During the Company&#8217;s fiscal years ended
December 31, 2025 and 2024 and the subsequent interim period through October 20, 2026, neither the Company nor anyone acting on its behalf
consulted with MBP Global regarding</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 0.25in"/><td style="width: 0.5in">(i)</td><td style="text-align: justify">the application of accounting principles to a specified transaction, either completed or proposed, or
the type of audit opinion that might be rendered on the Company&#8217;s financial statements, and neither a written report nor oral advice
was provided to the Company that MBP Global concluded was an important factor considered by the Company in reaching a decision as to any
accounting, auditing or financial reporting issue, or</td></tr></table>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 0.25in"/><td style="width: 0.5in">(ii)</td><td style="text-align: justify">any matter that was the subject of a &#8220;disagreement&#8221; (as defined in Item 304(a)(1)(iv) of Regulation
S-K and the related instructions);</td></tr></table>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 0.25in"/><td style="width: 0.5in">(iii)</td><td style="text-align: justify">or any &#8220;reportable event&#8221; (as defined in Item 304(a)(1)(v) of Regulation S-K).</td></tr></table>
